```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)

# Build the data for the explorer from the installed version of ftolr, so it
# is regenerated (and stays in sync with the other pages) every time the site
# is rendered. All joining is done here so the browser only does lookups.

# Version of the PPG taxonomy used to build this FTOL release (the `load_ppg()`
# version in the ftol pipeline's _targets.R). ftolr does not record it, so
# UPDATE THIS BY HAND at each release (see docs/updating.md, website step).
ppg_ver <- "2.0.0"

ftol_ver <- ftolr::ft_data_ver()
gb_release <- ftolr::ft_data_ver("gb")

# Taxonomy: one row per NCBI taxid
match_results <- ftolr::ftol_match_results |>
  mutate(ncbi_taxid = parse_number(taxid)) |>
  select(
    ncbi_taxid, query, matched_name, resolved_name,
    matched_status, match_type
  )
stopifnot(!anyNA(match_results$ncbi_taxid))

acc_tax <- ftolr::accessions_long |>
  select(species, locus, accession, seq_len, ncbi_taxid) |>
  left_join(match_results, by = "ncbi_taxid") |>
  arrange(species, locus)

voucher <- ftolr::accessions_wide |>
  select(species, join_by, specimen_voucher, publication, outgroup)

species_list <- sort(voucher$species)

explorer_data <- lapply(species_list, function(sp) {
  d <- acc_tax[acc_tax$species == sp, ]
  tax <- d |>
    select(
      accession, ncbi_taxid, query, matched_name, resolved_name,
      matched_status, match_type
    )
  # If every accession has the same taxonomy, show a single row without
  # the accession column
  tax_simple <- unique(select(tax, -accession))
  per_accession <- nrow(tax_simple) != 1
  list(
    acc = select(d, locus, accession, seq_len),
    voucher = as.list(voucher[voucher$species == sp, -1]),
    tax = if (per_accession) tax else tax_simple,
    tax_per_accession = per_accession
  )
})
names(explorer_data) <- species_list

jsonlite::write_json(
  list(
    ftol_ver = ftol_ver,
    gb_release = gb_release,
    species = species_list,
    data = explorer_data
  ),
  "explorer_data.json",
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  na = "null",
  dataframe = "rows",
  digits = NA
)

# Taxonium config (same as the Tree viewer page). The "[" and "]" are
# removed, as in viewer.Rmd.
config_string <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  list(
    source = paste("GenBank release", gb_release),
    title = paste0("FTOL v", ftol_ver)
  ),
  auto_unbox = TRUE
) |>
  as.character()

ojs_define(config_string = config_string)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
explorer = FileAttachment("explorer_data.json").json()
```

Select a species to see its GenBank accessions, specimen voucher, and
taxonomy in FTOL v`r ftol_ver` (GenBank release `r gb_release`). You can
type into the search box to auto-complete.


```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
{
  // Keep the URL in sync so that the current species can be shared
  const url = new URL(location.href);
  url.searchParams.set("species", species);
  history.replaceState(null, "", url);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Helpers to build tables with links
// Plain HTML table (no row-selection checkboxes)
makeTable = (rows, cols, format = {}) => html`<table class="table table-sm table-hover">
  <thead><tr>${cols.map((c) => html`<th>${c}</th>`)}</tr></thead>
  <tbody>${rows.map((r) => html`<tr>${cols.map((c) => html`<td>${
    r[c] == null ? "" : format[c] ? format[c](r[c]) : String(r[c])
  }</td>`)}</tr>`)}</tbody></table>`

nuccore = (acc) =>
  html`<a href="https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/nuccore/${acc}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${acc}</a>`
taxlink = (id) =>
  html`<a href="https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Taxonomy/Browser/wwwtax.cgi?id=${id}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${id}</a>`

taxCols = sp.tax_per_accession
  ? ["accession", "ncbi_taxid", "query", "matched_name", "resolved_name",
     "matched_status", "match_type"]
  : ["ncbi_taxid", "query", "matched_name", "resolved_name",
     "matched_status", "match_type"]

// Link to the species in the tree (Taxonium)
treeUrl = {
  const base = "https://taxonium.org/?treeUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Ffernphy%2Fftol_vis%2Fmain%2F_targets%2Fuser%2Ftaxonium%2Fftol_tree.tree&ladderizeTree=true&treeType=nwk&metaUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Ffernphy%2Fftol_vis%2Fmain%2F_targets%2Fuser%2Ftaxonium%2Fftol_data.csv&metaType=meta_csv&xType=x_dist&color=%7B%22field%22%3A%22meta_family%22%7D";
  const config = encodeURIComponent(config_string.replace(/[\[\]]/g, ""));
  const srch = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify([{
    key: "aa1", type: "name", method: "text_match", text: species,
    gene: "S", position: 484, new_residue: "any", min_tips: 0
  }]));
  return `${base}&config=${config}&srch=${srch}&zoomToSearch=0`;
}
```

## Data

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Species selection with a searchable (auto-completing) text box.
// Species can be preselected with a URL parameter, e.g. ?species=Equisetum_arvense
viewof speciesInput = {
  const initial = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("species");
  const start = explorer.species.includes(initial)
    ? initial
    : explorer.species[0];
  const MAX = 10;
  const input = html`<input type="text" value="${start}" class="form-control"
    placeholder="Start typing a species name" autocomplete="off"
    role="combobox" aria-label="Species" aria-expanded="false">`;
  const menu = html`<ul class="list-group shadow-sm" role="listbox"
    style="display:none; margin-top:2px; max-height:20em;
    overflow-y:auto"></ul>`;
  const wrap = html`<div style="max-width:28em"
    >${input}${menu}</div>`;
  wrap.value = start;
  let matches = [];
  let active = -1;

  const find = (q) => {
    q = q.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/ /g, "_");
    if (!q) return [];
    const starts = [], contains = [];
    for (const s of explorer.species) {
      const l = s.toLowerCase();
      if (l.startsWith(q)) starts.push(s);
      else if (l.includes(q)) contains.push(s);
      if (starts.length >= MAX) break;
    }
    return starts.concat(contains).slice(0, MAX);
  };
  const close = () => { menu.style.display = "none"; active = -1;
    input.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false"); };
  const choose = (s) => {
    input.value = s;
    close();
    wrap.value = s;
    wrap.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input"));
  };
  const render = () => {
    menu.replaceChildren(...matches.map((s, i) => {
      const li = html`<li class="list-group-item list-group-item-action py-1"
        role="option" style="cursor:pointer">${s}</li>`;
      if (i === active) li.classList.add("active");
      li.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); choose(s); });
      return li;
    }));
    const open = matches.length > 0;
    menu.style.display = open ? "block" : "none";
    input.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
  };
  input.addEventListener("input", (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    matches = find(input.value);
    active = -1;
    render();
  });
  input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") { active = Math.min(active + 1, matches.length - 1); render(); e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") { active = Math.max(active - 1, 0); render(); e.preventDefault(); }
    else if (e.key === "Enter") {
      const pick = active >= 0 ? matches[active]
        : explorer.species.includes(input.value) ? input.value : matches[0];
      if (pick) choose(pick);
      e.preventDefault();
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") close();
  });
  input.addEventListener("focus", () => input.select());
  // On leaving the box, restore the current valid species if the text is not one
  input.addEventListener("blur", () => { close(); input.value = wrap.value; });
  return wrap;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
species = speciesInput
sp = explorer.data[species]
```

### Accession

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
makeTable(sp.acc, ["locus", "accession", "seq_len"], { accession: nuccore })
```

### Voucher

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
makeTable([sp.voucher], ["join_by", "specimen_voucher", "publication", "outgroup"])
```

### Taxonomy

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
makeTable(sp.tax, taxCols, { accession: nuccore, ncbi_taxid: taxlink })
```

## How to use

Start by selecting a species from the search box. Species names are
shown with underscores in place of spaces, as in the tree. Clicking a
GenBank accession or an NCBI taxonomic ID opens a new browser tab for that
record.

### Accession

One row per accession for the selected species.

- **locus**: Name of locus (gene or region)
- **accession**: GenBank accession number
- **seq_len**: Length of the sequence in basepairs

### Voucher

Only one row.

- **join_by**: Method used to join sequences across loci within the species.
- **specimen_voucher**: Specimen voucher, converted to all lowercase and with
  spaces and punctuation removed to allow for matching.
- **publication**: Publication for the accession(s).
- **outgroup**: TRUE if species is in outgroup (non-ferns); FALSE if not
  (ferns)

### Taxonomy

May have just one row if the data are the same for all accessions, or one row
per accession if different accessions have different data.

The reference taxonomy is the
[Pteridophyte Phylogeny Group (PPG) taxonomy](https://github.com/pteridogroup/ppg),
version `r ppg_ver`
([release notes](https://github.com/pteridogroup/ppg/releases/tag/v`r ppg_ver`)).
NCBI names are matched to PPG names, and synonyms are resolved to the accepted
name in PPG.

- **accession**: GenBank accession number. Only appears if different
  accessions have different data.
- **ncbi_taxid**: NCBI taxonomic ID for the accession (or species).
- **query**: NCBI species name of accession used as query for name
  resolution.
- **matched_name**: Name matched by
  [taxastand](https://github.com/joelnitta/taxastand) when querying the NCBI
  name against the PPG taxonomic database.
- **resolved_name**: The name ultimately used for FTOL; if the match was a
  synonym, the resolved name is the accepted name.
- **matched_status**: Taxonomic status of the matched name (typically, either
  "accepted" or "synonym").
- **match_type**: Type of match. For more information, see the
  [taxastand vignette](https://joelnitta.github.io/taxastand/articles/basics.html#name-matching).

:::
